hint.input: Paste an email, a thread, your notes… The links inside are pulled out. Image and media links (X/Twitter, Reddit, thumbnails…) are left out.
hint.dest: Pick an existing folder, or type its name to search it — create a new one from the main window first if you need it.
hint.images: These look like image files. Tick the ones you do want to keep.

note.ignored: {{count}} image/media link(s) ignored (X/Twitter, Reddit, YouTube thumbnails…).
note.none: No links were found in that text.
